purpose: LLM comparison for content creation, SEO, and site development tasks

tasks.description: Generating JSON-LD, optimizing meta tags for CTR, and ensuring site-wide technical SEO health.

recommendation.reason: Native integration with Google search logic and superior at generating valid Schema.org/JSON-LD structures.
recommendation.notes: Use DeepSeek for bulk meta-tag generation to keep API costs near zero.

tasks.description: Writing the core 'Book vs. Movie' analysis. High focus on 'vibe,' emotional honesty, and spoiler-heavy depth.

recommendation.reason: Unmatched at 'human' prose. It avoids the generic AI cheerfulness, allowing for the 'no sugarcoating' tone requested.
recommendation.notes: Use Grok when the adaptation is based on a viral/trending topic for a sharper, more modern edge.

tasks.description: Transforming raw research into your specific .json format for the site injection pipeline.

recommendation.reason: Highest 'coding logic per dollar' ratio. It follows strict JSON schemas perfectly without the conversational filler.
recommendation.notes: DeepSeek is the workhorse here; it can process 1,000 titles for the cost of 10 in Claude.

tasks.description: Finding upcoming 2026/2027 adaptations, casting rumors, and tracking viral 'book-tok' trends.

recommendation.reason: Direct access to real-time data flows on X. Best at spotting what's trending before it hits traditional SEO tools.
recommendation.notes: Grok is for 'The Hype'; Perplexity is for 'The Facts' (release dates, crew, budget).

tasks.description: Designing 'shelves,' hero sections, and alphabetized browse components in the Astro environment.

recommendation.reason: Best-in-class for front-end code generation and understanding complex CSS/HTML relationships.
recommendation.notes: Grok is surprisingly agile at drafting rapid UI experiments in a conversational 'live' mode.

general_guidelines.current_focus: Transitioning from a 'list' to a 'discovery engine' while maintaining high affiliate conversion.
general_guidelines.recommended_workflow: Grok (Trend Scan) -> DeepSeek (Bulk Ingestion) -> Claude (Voice/Tone Polish) -> Gemini (SEO/Schema Audit)
